read_from_paper.freq_pool: adaptive average pool to 1, temporal axis preserved
read_from_paper.attention: ReLU then softmax over the node axis, heads averaged

inferred.static_matrix: INFERRED: exponential decay in hop count along the fibre, row-normalised. The paper says only that it maps physical sensor separation.
inferred.readout: INFERRED: centre node, mean-pooled over time frames. The label belongs to the centre locus, and the paper does not state the pooling.
inferred.dropout: INFERRED: 0.2 in the GCN blocks (value not stated).
inferred.node_count_note: The paper says 'seventeen adjacent sensor channels' and also 'one central node and four neighbours on each side' (= 9). We follow the stated 17.

read_from_paper.their_split: 80/10/10 over pre-segmented windows, stored in advance

inferred.mfcc_f_max: INFERRED: the paper lists f_max = 500 Hz alongside a sampling frequency of 756 Hz, but the Tomasov release is 20 kHz. Taken as the Nyquist limit unless overridden; at 500 Hz almost every mel filter is empty.
inferred.concat_length: INFERRED: the three transforms do not sum to 8192, so the concatenation is trimmed or zero-padded to the stated input dimension of 8192.

read_from_paper.paths: step-wise (channels as sequence) and channel-wise (attributes as sequence), fused by a two-unit softmax gate
read_from_paper.classifier: linear then softmax over concatenated branch outputs

inferred.attribute_grouping: Table 1 of the paper lists 7 time, 6 waveform and 11 spectral attributes; we follow that grouping exactly.
inferred.sequence_length: L is the channel count. We use the same spatial neighbourhood as S2-DyGNN so all three models see identical spatial context.

comparators.source: Jeong et al., Sensors 26(14):4417, Section 6.3 and Table 3

read_from_paper.standardisation: the paper states that input formats and training hyperparameters were standardised across all models to match S2-DyGNN, which is what we do

inferred.shared_front_end: INFERRED: all three reuse S2-DyGNN's asymmetric frequency-time CNN, so aggregation is the only variable. The paper does not print their front ends.
inferred.gcn_topology: INFERRED: chain graph over adjacent channels with self loops, symmetrically normalised (Kipf and Welling).
inferred.gat_heads: INFERRED: 2, matching S2-DyGNN's attention head count.
inferred.cnn_lstm_readout: INFERRED: LSTM per node, node representations mean-pooled. Mean pooling adds no relational term, which matches their statement that inter-node relationships remain unmodelled.
inferred.baseline_cnn: The baseline CNN of their Table 3 processes each node as an independent 1D signal, which is the Tomasov CNN already reconstructed in dasfe.baselines; it is not duplicated here.

this_notebook.training_budget: 30 epochs, early stopping patience 10, identical for every architecture
